ValidationRule.description: Incoming Exchange Transcript Dispatched can be checked only when all transcript section input fields are populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Incoming_Exchange_Exit_Clearance' && ISCHANGED(Transcript_Dispatched__c) && Transcript_Dispatched__c && ( ISBLANK(Transcript_Notes__c) || ISBLANK(Tracking_Number__c) || ISPICKVAL(Delivery_Mode__c, '') || ISBLANK(Dispatch_Address__c) || ISPICKVAL(Dispatch_Mode__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before checking Transcript Dispatched, complete all Transcript section fields: Transcript Notes, Tracking Number, Delivery Mode, Dispatch Address, and Dispatch Mode.
